invariants.rationale: By specification, getPadY() returns the sum of padTop.get(this) and padBottom.get(this).
It is reasonable to expect padding values are non-negative, making their sum non-negative as well (if padTop and padBottom are always non-negative).
Since the result is padTop.get(this) + padBottom.get(this), and padBottom.get(this) is likely non-negative, result should be at least as large as padTop.get(this).
Similarly, the result should be at least as large as padBottom.get(this).
If getPadTop() and getPadBottom() are equivalent to padTop.get(this) and padBottom.get(this), this provides an alternate view of the invariant.
